learningGoals: To help children identify and name common fruits and vegetables in English. 🥦
To understand the importance of eating healthy food every day to grow big and strong. 💪
To learn the names of our daily meals like breakfast, lunch, and dinner. 🍽️
To encourage good eating habits and an appreciation for trying new, healthy foods. 🥗
teachingTips: Involve your child in the kitchen! Ask them to name the vegetables out loud as you wash or chop them. 🥒
Talk about the beautiful colors of the food on their plate to make mealtime a fun learning experience. 🌈
Encourage them to practice good table manners by saying 'Please' and 'Thank you' during family meals. ✨
Discuss why we eat certain healthy foods, like how drinking milk makes our teeth and bones strong! 🥛

funActivities.title: Grocery Sorting Fun 🛒
funActivities.description: After grocery shopping, ask your child to help you separate the fruits from the vegetables and name each item out loud.

funActivities.title: Rainbow Plate 🌈
funActivities.description: Try to include foods of different colors in one meal (like red tomatoes, green cucumbers, and yellow dal) and count the colors together.

funActivities.title: My Favourite Meal Drawing 🎨
funActivities.description: Give your child a paper plate and ask them to draw their favorite healthy meal on it using bright crayons.
